newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Bomb explodes in Honduran capital, no injuries.
newsitem.headline: Bomb explodes in Honduran capital, no injuries.

text.p: A bomb exploded outside the Economics Ministry on Saturday, causing damages but no injuries in the second attack in two days, police and witnesses said.
"A bomb made from a pound of military dynamite exploded this morning in front of the ministry causing a small amount of damages but no casualties," an official with the police anti-bomb squad said.
No group immediately claimed responsibility for the blast.
A grenade attack on the Honduran capital's main courthouse on Thursday killed one person and injured 25. The blast was claimed by a previously unknown group called "CJ."
The government said the grenade attack was aimed at stopping the investigation of corruption under the previous government and human rights abuses by the military.
The lastest blast came as troops were deployed in the capital and in the northern city of San Pedro Sula to quell the wave of violence.
